LESSON: MIRACLES OF JESUS CHRIST (THE ROMAN OFFICER’S SERVANT)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Miracles of Jesus Christ (The Roman Officer’s servant)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Miracles of Jesus Christ (The Roman Officer’s servant), part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how they prayed for a sick person. How did the Roman officer demonstrate faith in God?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Miracles of Jesus Christ (The Roman Officer’s servant) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

• Love: is acquired as learners learn about care and concern for others as portrayed by the Roman officer.
